popularity: Score 0-100 = 55% English Wikipedia pageviews over the last 12 months (log scale) + 45% number of Wikipedia language editions with an article, plus any editorial boost from the seed. rank 1 = most popular.

landmarks.name: Mount Everest
landmarks.description: Earth's highest mountain
landmarks.summary: Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth above sea level. It lies in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas and marks part of the China–Nepal border at its summit. 86 m.

credit.title: File:Mt. Everest from Gokyo Ri November 5, 2012.jpg
credit.author: Rdevany
credit.credit: This is a digital photograph that I took

landmarks.name: Taj Mahal
landmarks.description: Marble mausoleum in Agra, India
landmarks.summary: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. It was commissioned in 1631 by the fifth Mughal emperor, Shah Jahan, to house the tomb of his late wife, Mumtaz Mahal; it also houses the tomb of Shah Jahan himself.

credit.title: File:Taj Mahal (Edited).jpeg
credit.author: Yann ; edited by Jim Carter
credit.credit: Edited version of File:Taj Mahal, Agra, India.jpg

landmarks.name: Eiffel Tower
landmarks.description: Tower in Paris, France
landmarks.summary: The Eiffel Tower is a lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower from 1887 to 1889.

landmarks.name: Great Wall of China
landmarks.description: Series of fortifications in northern China
landmarks.summary: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications in China. They were built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states and Imperial China as protection against various nomadic groups from the Eurasian Steppe. The first walls date to the 7th century BC; these were joined together in the Qin dynasty.

credit.title: File:The Great Wall of China at Jinshanling-edit.jpg
credit.author: Severin.stalder

landmarks.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
landmarks.description: Mountain in Tanzania, highest in Africa
landmarks.summary: Mount Kilimanjaro is a large dormant stratovolcano in Tanzania. It is the highest mountain in Africa and the highest free-standing mountain above sea level in the world, at 5,895 m (19,341 ft) above sea level and 4,900 m (16,100 ft) above its plateau base.

credit.title: File:Kilimanjaro from Amboseli.jpg
credit.author: Sergey Pesterev
credit.credit: Own work Alternative: https://unsplash.com/photos/DWXR-nAbxCk Sergey Pesterev

landmarks.name: Statue of Liberty
landmarks.description: Colossal sculpture in New York Harbor
landmarks.summary: The Statue of Liberty is a colossal neoclassical sculpture of a robed and crowned woman located on Liberty Island, part of New York City, in New York Harbor.

credit.title: File:Front view of Statue of Liberty (cropped).jpg
credit.author: AskALotl

landmarks.name: Burj Khalifa
landmarks.description: Skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
landmarks.summary: The Burj Khalifa is a megatall skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. 8 m and a roof height of 828 m (2,717 ft). It has been the tallest building in the world since its complete inauguration in 2011, surpassing Taipei 101, which had held the record since 2004.

landmarks.name: Colosseum
landmarks.description: Ancient Roman amphitheater in Rome
landmarks.summary: The Colosseum is an elliptical amphitheatre in the centre of the city of Rome, Italy, just east of the Roman Forum. It is the largest ancient amphitheatre ever built, and is the largest standing amphitheatre in the world. Construction began under Emperor Vespasian in 72 and was completed in AD 80 under his successor and heir, Titus.

landmarks.name: Hagia Sophia
landmarks.description: Mosque and former church in Istanbul, Turkey
landmarks.summary: Hagia Sophia, officially the Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, is a mosque and a major cultural and historical site in Istanbul, Turkey. It was formerly a church (360–1453) and a museum (1935–2020).

credit.title: File:Hagia Sophia (228968325).jpeg
credit.author: Adli Wahid
credit.credit: Imported from 500px ( archived version ) by the Archive Team . ( detail page )

landmarks.name: Louvre
landmarks.description: Art museum in Paris, France
landmarks.summary: The Louvre is a national art museum in Paris, France. It is located on the Right Bank of the Seine in the city's 1st arrondissement (district) and home to some of the most canonical works of Western art, including the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory.

landmarks.name: Machu Picchu
landmarks.description: 15th-century Inca citadel in Peru
landmarks.summary: Machu Picchu is a 15th-century Inca citadel located in the Eastern Cordillera of southern Peru on a mountain ridge at 2,430 meters (7,970 ft).

landmarks.name: Kaaba
landmarks.description: Building at the center of Masjid al-Haram
landmarks.summary: The Kaaba, also spelled Kaʽba, Kaʽbah or Kabah, sometimes referred to as al-Kaʽba al-Musharrafa, is a stone building at the center of Islam's most important mosque and holiest site, the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. It is considered by Muslims to be the Baytullah and determines the qibla for Muslims around the world.

credit.title: File:The Ka'ba, Great Mosque of Mecca, Saudi Arabia (4).jpg
credit.author: Richard Mortel

landmarks.name: White House
landmarks.description: Residence and workplace of the US president
landmarks.summary: The White House is the official residence and workplace of the president of the United States. S. president since John Adams in 1800 when the national capital was moved from Philadelphia. The White House is also a metonym for the Executive Office of the President.

credit.title: File:WhiteHouseSouthFacadeHDR.jpg
credit.author: This image or media was taken or created by Matt H. Wade . To see his entire portfolio, click here . @ thatmattwade This image is protected by copyright ! If you would like to use it, please read this first.

landmarks.name: Sagrada Família
landmarks.description: Basilica under construction since 1882 in Barcelona, Spain
landmarks.summary: Basílica i Temple Expiatori de la Sagrada Família, or simply Sagrada Família, is a Catholic Basilica under construction in the Eixample district of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. Designed by the Spanish architect Antoni Gaudí, it is the tallest church in the world.

landmarks.name: Angkor Wat
landmarks.description: Buddhist temple complex in Cambodia
landmarks.summary: Angkor Wat is a Theravada Buddhist temple complex, originally built as a Vaishnava Hindu temple, in Siem Reap, Cambodia. It is the largest religious complex in the world.

landmarks.name: Empire State Building
landmarks.description: Office skyscraper in Manhattan, New York
landmarks.summary: The Empire State Building is a 102-story, supertall skyscraper in the Midtown South neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City, United States. The building was designed in the Art Deco style by Shreve, Lamb & Harmon and constructed between 1930 and 1931. Its name is derived from "Empire State", the nickname of New York state.

landmarks.name: Stonehenge
landmarks.description: Prehistoric monument in England
landmarks.summary: Stonehenge is a prehistoric megalithic structure on Salisbury Plain in Wiltshire, England, two miles (3 km) west of Amesbury. 1 m) wide, and weighing around 25 tons, topped by connecting horizontal lintel stones which are held in place with mortise and tenon joints—a feature unique among contemporary monuments.

landmarks.name: Mount Fuji
landmarks.description: Volcano in Japan
landmarks.summary: 24 m. It is the highest mountain in Japan, the second-highest volcano on any Asian island, and the seventh-highest peak of an island on Earth. Mount Fuji last erupted from 1707 to 1708.

credit.title: File:View of Mount Fuji from Ōwakudani 20211202.jpg
credit.author: Suicasmo

landmarks.name: St. Peter's Basilica
landmarks.description: Roman Catholic basilica and landmark in Vatican City
landmarks.summary: The Papal Basilica of Saint Peter in the Vatican, or simply St. Peter's Basilica, is a church of the Italian Renaissance located in Vatican City, an independent microstate enclaved within the city of Rome, Italy. It was initially planned in the 15th century by Pope Nicholas V and then Pope Julius II to replace the ageing Old St.

credit.title: File:Basilica di San Pietro in Vaticano September 2015-1a.jpg
credit.author: Alvesgaspar

landmarks.name: Great Barrier Reef
landmarks.description: Coral reef system in Queensland, Australia
landmarks.summary: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, composed of over 2,900 individual reefs and 900 islands stretching for over 2,300 kilometres (1,400 mi) over an area of approximately 344,400 square kilometres (133,000 mi2). The reef is located in the Coral Sea, off the coast of Queensland, Australia.

credit.title: File:Aerial View of Great Barrier Reef (Ank Kumar) 02.jpg
credit.author: Ank Kumar

landmarks.name: Niagara Falls
landmarks.description: Waterfalls between the United States and Canada
landmarks.summary: S. state of New York. The largest of the three is Horseshoe Falls, which straddles the international border of the two countries. It is also known as the Canadian Falls. The smaller American Falls and Bridal Veil Falls lie within the United States.

landmarks.name: Galápagos Islands
landmarks.description: Ecuadorian volcanic archipelago
landmarks.summary: The Galápagos Islands are an archipelago of volcanic islands in the Eastern Pacific, located around the equator, 485 nautical miles west of the mainland of South America. They form the Galápagos Province of the Republic of Ecuador, with a population of slightly over 33,450 in 2020.

credit.title: File:Lobo marino (Zalophus californianus wollebaeki), Punta Pitt, isla de San Cristóbal, islas Galápagos, Ecuador, 2015-07-24, DD 11.JPG
credit.author: Diego Delso

landmarks.name: Mount Rushmore
landmarks.description: Mountain with U.S. presidential sculptures
landmarks.summary: The Mount Rushmore National Memorial is a national memorial featuring a colossal sculpture carved into the granite face of Mount Rushmore in the Black Hills, about 2 mi (3 km) southwest of Keystone, South Dakota, United States.

landmarks.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
landmarks.description: Cathedral in Paris, France, built 1163–1345
landmarks.summary: Notre-Dame de Paris, often referred to simply as Notre-Dame, is a medieval Catholic cathedral and basilica on the Île de la Cité, in the 4th arrondissement of Paris, France. It is the cathedral church of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Paris.

landmarks.name: Petra
landmarks.description: Ancient rock-cut historical city in Jordan
landmarks.summary: Petra is an ancient city and archaeological site in southern Jordan. Famous for its rock-cut architecture and water conduit systems, Petra is also called the "Rose City" because of the colour of the sandstone from which it is carved. The city is one of the New 7 Wonders of the World and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

landmarks.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
landmarks.description: Bell tower in Pisa, Italy
landmarks.summary: The Leaning Tower of Pisa, or simply the Tower of Pisa, is the campanile, or freestanding bell tower, of Pisa Cathedral. It is known for its nearly four-degree lean, the result of an unstable foundation. The tower is one of three structures in Pisa's Cathedral Square, which includes the cathedral and Pisa Baptistry.

landmarks.name: Palace of Versailles
landmarks.description: Former royal residence in Versailles, France
landmarks.summary: The Palace of Versailles is a château and historic monument in Versailles in the Yvelines department of France, southwest of Paris. It served as the principal residence of the French kings Louis XIV, Louis XV, and Louis XVI.

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
landmarks.description: Bridge in the San Francisco Bay Area
landmarks.summary: 6 km) strait connecting San Francisco Bay and the Pacific Ocean in California, United States. S. Route 101 and California State Route 1 across the strait. S. Bicycle Route 95.

credit.title: File:Golden Gate Bridge as seen from Battery East.jpg
credit.author: Frank Schulenburg

landmarks.name: Grand Canyon
landmarks.description: Steep-sided canyon in Arizona, US
landmarks.summary: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile.

credit.title: File:Canyon River Tree (165872763).jpeg
credit.author: Lennart Sikkema
credit.credit: Imported from 500px ( archived version ) by the Archive Team . ( detail page )

landmarks.name: Forbidden City
landmarks.description: Imperial palace complex in Beijing, China
landmarks.summary: The Forbidden City is the imperial palace complex in the center of the Imperial City in Beijing, China. It was the residence of twenty-four Ming and Qing dynasty Emperors and was the center of political power in China from 1420 to 1924.

landmarks.name: Taipei 101
landmarks.description: Skyscraper in Taiwan
landmarks.summary: Taipei 101, formerly known as the Taipei World Financial Center, is a 508-meter, 101-story skyscraper in Taipei, Taiwan. It is owned by the Taipei Financial Center Corporation. It was officially classified as the world's tallest building from its opening on 31 December 2004 until it was surpassed by the Burj Khalifa in 2009.

landmarks.name: Chichén Itzá
landmarks.description: Pre-Columbian Maya city in Mexico
landmarks.summary: Chichen Itza was a large pre-Columbian city built by the Maya people of the Terminal Classic period. The archeological site is located in Tinúm Municipality, Yucatán, Mexico, between the cities of Valladolid and Mérida.

landmarks.name: Christ the Redeemer
landmarks.description: Colossal statue in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
landmarks.summary: Christ the Redeemer is an Art Deco statue of Jesus in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, created by French-Polish sculptor Paul Landowski and built by Brazilian engineer Heitor da Silva Costa, in collaboration with French engineer Albert Caquot and Romanian sculptor Gheorghe Leonida who sculpted the face.

landmarks.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
landmarks.description: Palace in Bavaria, Germany
landmarks.summary: Neuschwanstein Castle is a 19th-century historicist palace on a rugged hill of the foothills of the Alps in the very south of Germany, near the border with Austria.

landmarks.name: Terracotta Army
landmarks.description: Collection of ancient Chinese military statues
landmarks.summary: The Terracotta Army is a collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first emperor of China. It is a form of funerary art buried with the emperor in 210–209 BCE in his mausoleum with the purpose of protecting him in his afterlife.

landmarks.name: Mont-Saint-Michel
landmarks.description: Tidal island in Normandy, France
landmarks.summary: Mont-Saint-Michel is a tidal island and mainland commune in Normandy, France.

landmarks.name: Acropolis of Athens
landmarks.description: Ancient citadel above the city of Athens
landmarks.summary: The Acropolis of Athens is an ancient citadel located on a rocky outcrop above the city of Athens, Greece, and contains the remains of several ancient buildings of great architectural and historical significance, the most famous being the Parthenon.

credit.title: File:1029 Acropolis of Athens in Greece at night Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg
credit.author: Giles Laurent

landmarks.name: Alhambra
landmarks.description: Palace and fortress complex in Granada, Spain
landmarks.summary: The Alhambra is a palace and fortress complex located in Granada, Spain. It is one of the most famous monuments of Islamic architecture and the only well-preserved palace from the medieval Islamic world. Additionally, the palace contains notable examples of Spanish Renaissance architecture.

credit.title: File:Dawn Charles V Palace Alhambra Granada Andalusia Spain.jpg
credit.author: Jebulon

landmarks.name: Big Ben
landmarks.description: Clock tower in London, England
landmarks.summary: Big Ben is the nickname for the Great Bell of the Great Clock of Westminster, and, by extension, for the clock tower that stands at the north end of the Palace of Westminster in London, England. Originally named the Clock Tower, the structure was renamed the Elizabeth Tower in 2012 to mark the Diamond Jubilee of Queen Elizabeth II.

credit.title: File:Elizabeth Tower and the north front of the Palace of Westminster, London.jpg
credit.author: Christian David

landmarks.name: Persepolis
landmarks.description: Ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire
landmarks.summary: Persepolis was the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire. It is situated in the plains of Marvdasht, encircled by the southern Zagros Mountains, Fars province of Iran. It is one of the key Iranian cultural heritage sites and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

credit.title: File:2018-09-21 Iran, Persepolis, Tachara (from the southeast).jpg
credit.author: Laurens R. Krol

landmarks.name: Sydney Opera House
landmarks.description: Performing arts centre in Australia
landmarks.summary: The Sydney Opera House is a multi-venue performing arts centre in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. Located on the foreshore of Sydney Harbour, it is widely regarded as one of the world's most famous and distinctive buildings, and a masterpiece of 20th-century architecture.

landmarks.name: Dome of the Rock
landmarks.description: Islamic building in Al-Aqsa, Jerusalem
landmarks.summary: The Dome of the Rock is an octagonal Islamic shrine at the center of the Al-Aqsa mosque compound on the Temple Mount in the Old City of Jerusalem.

landmarks.name: Uluru
landmarks.description: Sandstone monolith in the Northern Territory, Australia
landmarks.summary: Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock and officially gazetted as Uluru / Ayers Rock, is a large sandstone monolith. It crops out near the centre of Australia in the southern part of the Northern Territory, 335 km (208 mi) south-west of Alice Springs.

landmarks.name: Victoria Falls
landmarks.description: Waterfall on the Zambezi River in Zambia and Zimbabwe
landmarks.summary: Victoria Falls is a waterfall on the Zambezi River, located on the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe. It is one of the world's largest waterfalls, with a width of 1,708 m (5,604 ft). The region around it has a high degree of biodiversity in both plants and animals.

landmarks.name: Petronas Towers
landmarks.description: Interlinked supertall skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
landmarks.summary: 9 m (1,483 ft). From 1998 to 2004, they were the tallest buildings in the world until they were surpassed by the Taipei 101 skyscraper in Taiwan.

landmarks.name: Cappadocia
landmarks.description: Historical region in Central Anatolia, Turkey
landmarks.summary: Cappadocia is a historical region in Central Anatolia region, Turkey. It is largely in the provinces of Nevşehir, Kayseri, Aksaray, Kırşehir, Sivas and Niğde. Today, the touristic Cappadocia Region is located in Nevşehir province.

landmarks.name: Matterhorn
landmarks.description: Mountain in the Swiss and Italian Alps
landmarks.summary: The Matterhorn is a mountain of the Alps, straddling the main watershed and border between Switzerland and Italy. It is a large, near-symmetric pyramidal peak in the extended Monte Rosa area of the Pennine Alps, whose summit is 4,478 metres (14,692 ft) above sea level, making it one of the highest summits in the Alps and Europe.

credit.title: File:Matterhorn from Domhütte - 2.jpg
credit.author: Photo: chil, on Camptocamp.org Derivative work: Zacharie Grossen

landmarks.name: Golden Temple
landmarks.description: Sikh religious site in Punjab, India
landmarks.summary: The Golden Temple is a gurdwara located in Amritsar, Punjab, India. It is the pre-eminent spiritual site of Sikhism and its holiest site. The gurdwara complex is a collection of buildings around the sanctum sanctorum and the sarovar, known as the Amrit Sarovar.

landmarks.name: Brooklyn Bridge
landmarks.description: Bridge in New York City
landmarks.summary: The Brooklyn Bridge is a cable-stayed suspension bridge in New York City, spanning the East River between the boroughs of Manhattan and Brooklyn. Opened on May 24, 1883, the Brooklyn Bridge was the first fixed crossing of the East River. 7 m) above mean high water.

credit.title: File:Brooklyn Bridge and the Lower Manhattan skyline from Pebble Beach, New York.jpg
credit.author: Christian David

landmarks.name: CN Tower
landmarks.description: Communications and observation tower in Toronto, Canada
landmarks.summary: 3 ft) communications and observation tower in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Completed in 1976, it is located in downtown Toronto, built on the former Railway Lands. Its name "CN" refers to Canadian National, the railway company that built the tower.

credit.title: File:Toronto skyline viewed from Trillium Park.jpg
credit.author: Maksim Sokolov (maxergon.com)

landmarks.name: Moai of Easter Island
landmarks.description: Monolithic statues on Easter Island
landmarks.summary: Moai or moꞌai are monolithic human figures carved from stone by the Rapa Nui people, on Rapa Nui in eastern Polynesia between the years 1250 and 1500. Nearly half are still at Rano Raraku, the main moai quarry, but hundreds were transported from there and set on stone platforms called ahu around the island's perimeter.

credit.title: File:AhuTongariki.JPG
credit.author: Ian Sewell
credit.credit: IanAndWendy.com Photo gallery from Easter Island

landmarks.name: Iguazu Falls
landmarks.description: Waterfalls on the Iguazú River on the border of Argentina and Brazil
landmarks.summary: The Iguazú Falls or Iguaçu Falls are waterfalls of the Iguazu River on the border of the Argentine province of Misiones and the Brazilian state of Paraná. Together, they make up the largest waterfall system in the world. The falls divide the river into the upper and lower Iguazu.

landmarks.name: Tower Bridge
landmarks.description: Bridge over the Thames in London, England
landmarks.summary: Tower Bridge is a Grade I listed combined bascule, suspension, and, until 1960, cantilever bridge in London, built between 1886 and 1894, designed by Horace Jones and engineered by John Wolfe Barry with the help of Henry Marc Brunel.

landmarks.name: Teotihuacan
landmarks.description: Ancient Mesoamerican city
landmarks.summary: Teotihuacan is an ancient Mesoamerican city located in a sub-valley of the Valley of Mexico, which is located in the State of Mexico, 40 kilometers (25 mi) northeast of modern-day Mexico City.

credit.title: File:ZA77 Teotihuacán edo de mex Herberto de la rosa.jpg
credit.author: Hdlrosa

landmarks.name: Pyramids of Giza
landmarks.description: Archaeological site near Cairo, Egypt
landmarks.summary: The Giza pyramid complex in Egypt is home to the Great Pyramid, the pyramid of Khafre, and the pyramid of Menkaure, along with their associated pyramid complexes and the Great Sphinx. All were built during the Fourth Dynasty of the Old Kingdom of ancient Egypt, between c. 2600 – c. 2500 BC.

landmarks.name: Brandenburg Gate
landmarks.description: Triumphal arch and gate in Berlin, Germany
landmarks.summary: The Brandenburg Gate is an 18th-century neoclassical monument in Berlin, Germany. One of the best-known landmarks of the country, it was erected on the site of a former city gate that marked the start of the road from Berlin to Brandenburg an der Havel, the former capital of the Margraviate of Brandenburg.

landmarks.name: Angel Falls
landmarks.description: Tallest single drop waterfall in the world, Venezuela
landmarks.summary: Angel Falls is a waterfall in Venezuela. It is the world's tallest uninterrupted waterfall, with a height of 979 metres (3,212 ft), and a plunge of 807 m (2,648 ft). The waterfall drops over the edge of the Auyán-tepui mountain in the Canaima National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Gran Sabana region of Bolívar State.

landmarks.name: Santorini
landmarks.description: Greek island in the Aegean Sea
landmarks.summary: Santorini, officially Thira or Thera, is a Greek island in the southern Aegean Sea, about 200 km (120 mi) southeast from the mainland. It is the largest island of a small, circular archipelago formed by the Santorini caldera.

credit.title: File:1000 Three domes of Oia in Santorini Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg
credit.author: Giles Laurent

landmarks.name: Borobudur
landmarks.description: 9th-century Buddhist temple in Java, Indonesia
landmarks.summary: Borobudur, also transcribed Barabudur, is a 9th-century Mahayana Buddhist temple in Magelang Regency, near the town of Muntilan, northwest of the city of Yogyakarta, in Central Java, Indonesia.

landmarks.name: Times Square
landmarks.description: Intersection and area in Manhattan, New York
landmarks.summary: Times Square is one of the world's busiest pedestrian intersections, tourist destinations, and entertainment hubs. It is formed by the junction of Broadway, Seventh Avenue, and 42nd Street in Midtown Manhattan, New York City.

landmarks.name: Abu Simbel
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in southern Egypt
landmarks.summary: Abu Simbel is a historic site comprising two massive rock-cut temples in the village of Abu Simbel, Aswan Governorate, Upper Egypt, near the border with Sudan. It is located on the western bank of Lake Nasser, about 230 km (140 mi) southwest of Aswan.

landmarks.name: Bora Bora
landmarks.description: Island in French Polynesia
landmarks.summary: Bora Bora is a French island group in the Leeward Islands, comprising the western part of the Society Islands of French Polynesia, an overseas collectivity of the French Republic in the South Pacific. 55 km2 (12 sq mi). The main island, located about 230 kilometres northwest of Papeete, is surrounded by a lagoon and a barrier reef.

landmarks.name: Saint Basil's Cathedral
landmarks.description: 1561 Orthodox church in Moscow, Russia
landmarks.summary: The Cathedral of Vasily the Blessed, commonly known as Saint Basil's Cathedral, is a Russian Orthodox church on Red Square in the historic centre of Moscow. It is one of the most popular cultural symbols of Russia.

landmarks.name: Potala Palace
landmarks.description: Fortress in Lhasa, Tibet
landmarks.summary: Potala Palace is a museum complex in Lhasa, the capital of the Tibet Autonomous Region of China. It was formerly the winter palace of the Dalai Lamas, and from 1649 until 1959 served as the Dalai Lamas' residence. The palace complex became a museum following the annexation of Tibet by the People's Republic of China.

landmarks.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
landmarks.description: Bridge across Sydney Harbour in Australia
landmarks.summary: The Sydney Harbour Bridge is a steel through arch bridge in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, spanning Sydney Harbour from the central business district (CBD) to the North Shore. The view of the bridge, the harbour, and the nearby Sydney Opera House is widely regarded as an iconic image of Sydney, and of Australia itself.

landmarks.name: Sigiriya
landmarks.description: Ancient rock fortress near Dambulla, Sri Lanka
landmarks.summary: Sigiriya or Sinhagiri is an ancient rock fortress located in the northern Matale District near the town of Dambulla in the Central Province, Sri Lanka. It is a site of historical and archaeological significance that is dominated by a massive column of granite approximately 180 m (590 ft) high.

credit.title: File:Sigiriya (141688197).jpeg
credit.author: Wrobell
credit.credit: Imported from 500px ( archived version ) by the Archive Team . ( detail page )

landmarks.name: Ha Long Bay
landmarks.description: Bay in northern Vietnam
landmarks.summary: Hạ Long Bay or Halong Bay is a bay located in Northeastern Vietnam, administered by the city of Quảng Ninh. The name Hạ Long means "descending dragon". It features thousands of limestone karsts and islets in various shapes and sizes, for which it is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a popular travel destination.

landmarks.name: Monument Valley
landmarks.description: Region of the Colorado Plateau, US
landmarks.summary: Monument Valley is a region of the Colorado Plateau characterized by a cluster of sandstone buttes, with the largest reaching 1,000 ft (300 m) above the valley floor. The most famous butte formations are located in northeastern Arizona along the Utah–Arizona state line.

landmarks.name: Table Mountain
landmarks.description: Mountain overlooking Cape Town, South Africa
landmarks.summary: Table Mountain is a flat-topped mountain forming a prominent landmark overlooking the city of Cape Town in South Africa.

credit.title: File:Table Mountain DanieVDM.jpg
credit.author: Danie van der Merwe from Cape Town, South Africa
credit.credit: View of Table Mountain from Bloubergstrand

landmarks.name: Salar de Uyuni
landmarks.description: Salt flat in Bolivia
landmarks.summary: Salar de Uyuni is the largest salt flat in the world, with an area of approximately 10,582 square kilometres (4,086 mi2). It is situated in southwestern Bolivia, within the Daniel Campos Province of the Potosí Department, near the crest of the Andes Mountains, at an elevation of 3,656 m (11,995 ft) above sea level.

landmarks.name: Hollywood Sign
landmarks.description: Landmark in Los Angeles, California
landmarks.summary: The Hollywood Sign is an American landmark and cultural icon overlooking Hollywood, Los Angeles. Originally the Hollywoodland Sign, it is on Mount Lee, above Beachwood Canyon in the Santa Monica Mountains. 2 m) long. Due to increasing recognition, the sign was left up; the last four letters "LAND" were removed in 1949.

landmarks.name: Itsukushima Shrine
landmarks.description: Shinto shrine in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan
landmarks.summary: Itsukushima Shrine is a Shinto shrine on the island of Itsukushima, best known for its "floating" torii. It is in the city of Hatsukaichi, in Hiroshima Prefecture in Japan, accessible from the mainland by ferry at Miyajimaguchi Station.

landmarks.name: Las Vegas Strip
landmarks.description: Stretch of Las Vegas Boulevard with many resorts, shows, and casinos
landmarks.summary: The Las Vegas Strip is a stretch of Las Vegas Boulevard in Clark County, Nevada, that is known for its concentration of resort hotels and casinos. 8 km) long, and is immediately south of the Las Vegas city limits in the unincorporated towns of Paradise and Winchester, but is often referred to simply as "Las Vegas".

landmarks.name: Marina Bay Sands
landmarks.description: Integrated resort in Singapore
landmarks.summary: Marina Bay Sands is an integrated resort fronting Marina Bay in Singapore and a landmark of the city. 88 billion).

landmarks.name: Charles Bridge
landmarks.description: Medieval stone arch bridge across the Vltava river in Prague, Czechia
landmarks.summary: Charles Bridge is a medieval stone arch bridge that crosses the Vltava river in Prague, Czech Republic. Its construction started in 1357 under the auspices of King Charles IV, and finished in the early 15th century. The bridge replaced the old Judith Bridge built 1158–1172 that had been severely damaged by a flood in 1342.

credit.title: File:Prague 07-2016 view from Lesser Town Tower of Charles Bridge img3.jpg
credit.author: A.Savin

landmarks.name: Aït Benhaddou
landmarks.description: Historical village in southeastern Morocco
landmarks.summary: Aït Benhaddou is a historic ighrem or ksar along the former caravan route between the Sahara and Marrakesh in Morocco. It is considered a great example of Moroccan earthen clay architecture and has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1987.

credit.title: File:Ksar Aït Benhaddou, Marocco (أيت بن حدو، المغرب, ⴰⵢⵜ ⵃⴰⴷⴷⵓ).jpg
credit.author: Petar Milošević

landmarks.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
landmarks.description: Palace in Seoul, South Korea
landmarks.summary: Gyeongbokgung is a former royal palace in Seoul, South Korea. Established in 1395, it was the first royal palace of the Joseon dynasty, and is now one of the most significant tourist attractions in the country.

landmarks.name: Serengeti National Park
landmarks.description: National park in Tanzania
landmarks.summary: The Serengeti National Park is a large national park in northern Tanzania that stretches over 14,763 km2 (5,700 sq mi). It is located in eastern Mara Region and northeastern Simiyu Region and contains over 15,000 km2 (5,800 sq mi) of savanna. The park was established in 1940.

landmarks.name: Cliffs of Moher
landmarks.description: Sea cliffs in County Clare, Ireland
landmarks.summary: The Cliffs of Moher are sea cliffs located at the southwestern edge of the Burren region in County Clare, Ireland. They run for about 14 kilometres.

landmarks.name: Bagan
landmarks.description: UNESCO historical city in Mandalay Region, Myanmar
landmarks.summary: Bagan is a medieval city and a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Mandalay Region of Myanmar. From the 9th to 13th centuries, the city was the capital of the Pagan Kingdom, the first kingdom that unified the regions that would later constitute Myanmar.

credit.title: File:Bagan, Burma.jpg
credit.author: Corto Maltese 1999
credit.credit: Originally uploaded to Flickr as View over the plain of Bagan

landmarks.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
landmarks.description: Shinto shrine near Kyoto, Japan
landmarks.summary: Fushimi Inari-taisha is the head shrine of the kami Inari, located in Fushimi-ku, Kyoto, Japan. 5 mi) and take approximately 2 hours to walk up. It is unclear whether the mountain's name, Inariyama, or the shrine's name came first.

credit.title: File:Torii path with lantern at Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine, Kyoto, Japan.jpg
credit.author: Basile Morin

landmarks.name: Wadi Rum
landmarks.description: Valley in southern Jordan
landmarks.summary: Wadi Rum (Arabic: وادي رم Wādī Ramm, also Wādī al-Ramm, known also as the Valley of the Moon or Red mountains, is a valley cut into the sandstone and granite rock in southern Jordan, near the border with Saudi Arabia and about 60 km to the east of the city of Aqaba. With an area of 720 km2 it is the largest wadi in Jordan.

landmarks.name: Torres del Paine
landmarks.description: National park in southern Chilean Patagonia
landmarks.summary: Torres del Paine National Park is a national park encompassing mountains, glaciers, lakes, and rivers in southern Chilean Patagonia. The Cordillera del Paine group of mountains is the park's centerpiece. It lies in a transition area between the Magellanic subpolar forests and the Patagonian Steppes.

credit.title: File:Cuernos del Paine from Lake Pehoé.jpg
credit.author: Miguel Vieira ( talk · contribs )

landmarks.name: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
landmarks.description: National forest in Hunan, China
landmarks.summary: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park is a national forest park located in Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province, China. It is one of several national parks within the Wulingyuan Scenic Area.

landmarks.name: Wat Arun
landmarks.description: Buddhist temple in central Bangkok, Thailand
landmarks.summary: Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchawaramahawihan or Wat Arun is a Buddhist temple (wat) in the Bangkok Yai district of Bangkok, Thailand. It is situated in Thonburi on the west bank of the Chao Phraya River. The temple derives its name from the Hindu god Aruṇa, often personified as the rays of the rising sun.

credit.title: File:เจดีย์ประธานทรงปรางค์วัดอรุณ2.jpg
credit.author: Mastertongapollo

landmarks.name: Half Dome, Yosemite
landmarks.description: Granitic dome in Yosemite National Park, California
landmarks.summary: Half Dome is a quartz monzonite batholith at the eastern end of Yosemite Valley in Yosemite National Park, California. It is a well-known rock formation in the park, named for its distinct shape. One side is a sheer face while the other three sides are smooth and round, making it appear like a dome cut in half.

credit.title: File:Half Dome with Eastern Yosemite Valley (Zuschnitt).jpg
credit.author: Thomas Wolf , www.foto-tw.de

landmarks.name: Tiger's Nest (Paro Taktsang)
landmarks.description: Buddhist temple complex in Paro, Bhutan
landmarks.summary: Paro Taktsang is a sacred Vajrayana Himalayan Buddhist site located in the cliffside of the upper Paro valley in Bhutan. It is one of thirteen Tiger's Nest caves in which Padmasambhava practiced and taught Vajrayana.

credit.title: File:Paro Taktsang, Bhutan (edited).jpg
credit.author: Original: Nina R from Africa Derivative work: UnpetitproleX
credit.credit: Paro Taktsang, Bhutan This file was derived from: Paro Taktsang, Bhutan (49694480001).jpg

landmarks.name: Antelope Canyon
landmarks.description: Landform in the Navajo Nation, Arizona
landmarks.summary: Navajo Upper Antelope Canyon is a slot canyon in the American Southwest, on Navajo land east of Lechee, Arizona. It includes six separate, scenic slot canyon sections on the Navajo Reservation, referred to as Upper Antelope Canyon, Rattle Snake Canyon, Owl Canyon, Mountain Sheep Canyon, Canyon X and Lower Antelope Canyon.

landmarks.name: Registan
landmarks.description: Historical center of Samarkand, Uzbekistan
landmarks.summary: Registan, officially the Registan Square is a historic public square in the city of Samarkand, Uzbekistan. It served as the heart of the Timurid Empire and later as the city's commercial, educational, and ceremonial center.

credit.title: File:RegistanSquare Samarkand.jpg
credit.author: Registan_-_Gusjer.jpg : Gustavo Jeronimo from Aranjuez, Spain derivative work: MrPanyGoff

landmarks.name: Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone
landmarks.description: Largest hot spring in the United States
landmarks.summary: The Grand Prismatic Spring is the largest hot spring in the Yellowstone National Park, and the third largest in the world, after Frying Pan Lake in New Zealand and Boiling Lake in Dominica. It is located in the Midway Geyser Basin.

credit.title: File:Aerial image of Grand Prismatic Spring (view from the south).jpg
credit.author: Carsten Steger

landmarks.name: Milford Sound
landmarks.description: Fiord in the southwest of New Zealand's South Island
landmarks.summary: Milford Sound is a fiord in the south west of New Zealand's South Island within Fiordland National Park, Piopiotahi Marine Reserve, and the Te Wahipounamu World Heritage site. It has been judged the world's top travel destination in an international survey and is acclaimed as New Zealand's most famous tourist destination.

credit.title: File:Milford Sound (New Zealand).JPG
credit.author: Maros M r a z ( Maros )

landmarks.name: Grand Canal, Venice
landmarks.description: Water channel in Venice, Italy
landmarks.summary: The Grand Canal is the largest channel in Venice, Italy, forming one of the major water-traffic corridors in the city.

credit.title: File:View of the Grand Canal from Rialto to Ca'Foscari.jpg
credit.author: Didier Descouens

landmarks.name: Twelve Apostles
landmarks.description: Limestone stacks in Australia
landmarks.summary: The Twelve Apostles are a collection of limestone stacks off the shore of Port Campbell National Park, by the Great Ocean Road in Victoria, Australia.

landmarks.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
landmarks.description: Glacier located in the Patagonian Andes
landmarks.summary: The Perito Moreno, Francisco Gormaz or Bismarck Glacier is a glacier located in Los Glaciares National Park in southwest Santa Cruz Province, Argentina, and originated in the Magallanes Region in Chile, being also part of the Bernardo O'Higgins National Park. It is one of the most important tourist attractions in the Argentine Patagonia.

landmarks.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo
landmarks.description: Mountains in Italy
landmarks.summary: The Tre Cime di Lavaredo, also called the Drei Zinnen, are three distinctive battlement-like peaks, in the Sexten Dolomites of northeastern Italy. They are one of the best-known mountain groups in the Alps. The three peaks, from east to west, are:Cima Piccola / Kleine Zinne Cima Grande / Große Zinne Cima Ovest / Westliche Zinne.

landmarks.name: Moraine Lake
landmarks.description: Glacial lake in Alberta, Canada
landmarks.summary: 7 mi) outside the village of Lake Louise, Alberta, Canada. It is situated in the Valley of the Ten Peaks, at an elevation of approximately 1,884 metres (6,181 ft). The lake has a surface area of 50 hectares.

landmarks.name: Church of Saint George, Lalibela
landmarks.description: Rock-hewn church in Lalibela, Ethiopia
landmarks.summary: The Church of Saint George is one of eleven rock-hewn monolithic churches in Lalibela, a town in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia. Originally named Roha (Warwar), the historical and religious site was named Lalibela after the King Gebre Mesqel Lalibela of the Zagwe dynasty, who commissioned its construction.

landmarks.name: Victoria Harbour
landmarks.description: Harbour in Hong Kong
landmarks.summary: Victoria Harbour is a natural landform harbour in Hong Kong separating Hong Kong Island to the south from the Kowloon Peninsula to the north. It is a major trading hub, as well as a tourist attraction. Lying in the middle of the territory's dense urban region, the harbour is also the site of annual fireworks displays and promenades.

landmarks.name: Sossusvlei
landmarks.description: Salt and clay pan in the Namib Desert, Namibia
landmarks.summary: Sossusvlei is a salt and clay pan surrounded by high red dunes, located in the southern part of the Namib Desert, in the Namib-Naukluft National Park of Namibia. The name "Sossusvlei" is often used in an extended meaning to refer to the surrounding area. These landmarks are some of the major visitor attractions of Namibia.

landmarks.name: Avenue of the Baobabs
landmarks.description: Protected area in Madagascar
landmarks.summary: 8 between Morondava and Belon'i Tsiribihina in the Menabe region of western Madagascar. Its striking landscape draws travelers from around the world, making it one of the most visited locations in the region.
